messages:
Jules (CS): Heads-up — CedarPoint renewal in ~6w. Observed ~60% decline in API calls last 30d and they reported "partial outputs" plus intermittent 5xx spikes on their staging namespace. Procurement asked for a short reliability + cost note for their RFP. :warning:
Marco (Solutions): Yikes. Any example request IDs or endpoints called out?
Jules (CS): They called out /v1/chat-stream and /v1/embeddings. Errors cluster 16:30-17:15 CET. Pasted two sample lines from their support bundle:
```
2026-03-02T16:41:12Z ERROR 500 generation service="kv_cache_miss" latency=2.0s req=cp-xy-77
2026-03-02T16:53:05Z ERROR 502 batch_processor reason="batch_timeout" batch_size=1
```
Leah (Eng): Pattern = bursty small requests -> batch collapse -> KV cold churn + occasional stream terminations. I can run a replay with their request timings and measure tail latency. ETA ~3h.
Ben (AE): Procurement might be running an eval with ZephyrAI. They asked for p50/p95 latency, cost delta for a small dedicated pool, and a one-page mitigation plan. Strong preference from me to offer an operational trial vs discount.
Marco (Solutions): Suggested immediate plays: 1) quick client-side checklist (reduce max_wait_ms to 20-30ms, enable streaming retries); 2) offer 2-week dedicated routing trial during their eval window; 3) reproduce and capture before/after p50/p95 numbers for the exec note. I'll draft both an ops checklist and a procurement-friendly one-pager.
Jules (CS): New procurement contact is L. Hayes (non-technical). Their Head of Data left last week — new ML contact is TBD. Need an exec-friendly summary for procurement + a concise ops checklist for whoever picks up ML work.
Leah (Eng): If we confirm KV thrash, short-term config: lower tenant max_wait and increase tenant concurrency cap; medium-term: suggest prefix caching for common prompts. I'll share repro logs and screenshots.
ops-bot: Maintenance window scheduled 2026-03-03T01:00Z — tagging @Leah (Eng).
Leah (Eng): I'll ensure the replay excludes maintenance window.
Marco (Solutions): I'll include a fallback-model-variant line and a stabilization offer (2 weeks post-trial monitoring) in the exec doc.
Ben (AE): Action items: Marco - draft exec & ops one-pagers (owner: Marco) due EOD; Leah - run replay + share logs + quick config patch (owner: Leah) due in 3h; Ben - confirm whether ZephyrAI is in the RFP and procurement asks (owner: Ben) due before meeting; Jules - schedule 30m sync with procurement (owner: Jules) tomorrow.
Jules (CS): Meeting invite sent to L. Hayes, CedarPoint PM, Marco, Ben, and Leah — 09:30 CET tomorrow. Please be ready to request a short curl capture if we can't repro live.
Ben (AE): I'll push for the dedicated trial on the call and request their RFP scoring sheet.
Leah (Eng): If they can paste any truncated response examples, share here. Could be early stream termination from client timeouts.
Jules (CS): Will collect and paste truncated examples from ticket before the call. Thanks team :pray:
